bagPolicy.summary: You may bring a small bag to most shows. The Fitzgerald Theater does not have a coat check, so plan to keep anything you bring with you.
bagPolicy.quote: The Fitzgerald Theater does not have a coat check.

parking.summary: The Fitzgerald has ample paid metered street parking nearby, and the closest ramps include Victory and Lawson Commons. Street parking in St. Paul is free on Sundays.
parking.quote: The Fitzgerald Theater and Palace Theatre have ample paid metered street parking

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Fitzgerald Theater. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Fitzgerald Theater hasn't published food and drink details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

accessibility.summary: All First Avenue venues are wheelchair accessible. The Fitzgerald is fully seated with 2 balconies and no elevator, so the balconies are stairs only, while the Orchestra level and ADA seating need no stairs. Accessible seating buyers can add up to three ticketed companions, and assisted listening devices are available from staff on site; for other requests call (612) 338-8388.
accessibility.quote: The Orchestra level and ADA seating does not require stairs for access.

reEntry.summary: The Fitzgerald Theater hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: AXS Mobile ID in the AXS app is the main way in, and will call is available for most events if you don't have a smartphone. You need a valid photo ID to enter and to claim will call tickets. At age-limited shows, minors must be with a parent or legal guardian the whole time.
ticketPickup.quote: Yes, you will need a valid Photo ID to enter our venues, and also to claim will call tickets.

gates.summary: The Fitzgerald Theater hasn't published entrance and door details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
